headline: Laguna and Albuquerque
summary: Roosevelt campaigns in New Mexico at Laguna and Albuquerque.

headline: Taking on the trusts in Colorado
summary: Roosevelt speaks from Trinidad through Pueblo and Colorado Springs to Denver, hammering the trusts.

headline: On film in Pueblo
summary: Motion pictures capture Roosevelt speaking in Pueblo, Colorado. He then campaigns in Nebraska at Hastings, Lincoln, Minden and Omaha.
uncertain: Guest name may be OCR-garbled.

headline: Kansas allies gather
summary: Roosevelt speaks in Ottawa and Topeka and confers with Senator Joseph Bristow, Victor Murdock, Governor Stubbs, W. R. Nelson and William Allen White.

headline: Sunday at William Allen White's
summary: Roosevelt spends the day in Kansas as the guest of editor William Allen White.

references.title: William Allen White, Autobiography

uncertain: Source names only Kansas; White lived in Emporia but the town is not stated.

headline: Kansas into Missouri
summary: Roosevelt campaigns through southeastern Kansas towns such as Pittsburg, then crosses into Missouri for Lamar, Springfield, Aurora and Monett.
uncertain: Entry partly cut off; state assignment of some towns uncertain.

headline: Through Oklahoma
summary: Roosevelt campaigns in Tulsa, Chandler, Oklahoma City and McAlester.

headline: Waterways in Little Rock
summary: In Little Rock, Roosevelt speaks to a group promoting a Great Lakes-to-Gulf waterway.

headline: Memphis and Jackson
summary: Roosevelt speaks in Tennessee at Memphis and Jackson.

headline: A French Quarter parade
summary: On Corinne's 51st birthday, Roosevelt parades through New Orleans's French Quarter and gives a speech.

headline: Alabama and Atlanta
summary: Roosevelt speaks at Montgomery, Opelika and other Alabama towns and in Atlanta.
uncertain: Source lists Columbus and Macon under Alabama; they are likely the Georgia cities.

headline: Hecklers, then his mother's home
summary: Hecklers badly disrupt Roosevelt's Atlanta speech. He visits Roswell and Bulloch Hall, his mother's girlhood home.

headline: East Tennessee swing
summary: Roosevelt speaks at four East Tennessee stops, from Chattanooga to Knoxville. Funk publishes his collection "Conservation of Womanhood and Childhood."

events.detail: "Conservation of Womanhood and Childhood" issued by Funk
